variables.description: Public URL users reach. Used for OAuth redirect URIs, email links, and the dashboard. MUST be set to this deployment's Railway domain — otherwise GitHub OAuth and email links break. Railway fills this for you via the system variable, shown below.
variables.label: Public URL — auto-filled by Railway below
variables.helpText: Leave blank — the system variable on the next row injects the deployment's public domain automatically. Only override if you put a custom domain / CNAME in front.

variables.description: GitHub OAuth App Client ID for sign-in. Create at github.com/settings/developers → New OAuth App. Callback URL: <your deployment URL>/auth/github/callback.
variables.label: GitHub OAuth Client ID (recommended login)
variables.helpText: Strongly recommended — gives every visitor a real identity on the registry without you needing to configure a mail provider. Requires a GitHub OAuth App whose callback is set to https://<deployment>/auth/github/callback.

variables.description: Secret for the GitHub OAuth app above.
variables.label: GitHub OAuth Client Secret
variables.helpText: Leave blank if you are not using GitHub login. At least one identity provider (GitHub / Google / Resend email) is required for the first account.

variables.description: Resend API key for email OTP sign-in + team invites. Requires a Resend-verified sending domain (treg requires a real from-domain for SPF/DKIM).
variables.label: Resend API key (optional — email login)
variables.helpText: Only needed if you want users to log in by email OTP instead of (or in addition to) GitHub/Google. The sending domain must be verified in Resend for SPF/DKIM to pass.

variables.description: From header for transactional email. Defaults to tools-registry <no-reply@treg.to> — change to your verified domain.
variables.label: Email From header
